items.title: Alvin "Red" Tyler Interview, 1996-06-19
items.q: And the recording, the studio band was the nucleus of the Dave Bartholomew band. Earl Palmer, Frank Fields, Ernest McElaine, and I had, they brought in Lee Allen from the Paul Gatons band to do it.

ctx.x: Um... Let's see how it's low. So it's low. So it's low. So it's low. So it's low. So it's low. How did you see the recording sort of an industry here? Were you... When are you starting to do session work? I mean, outside of Dave? When are you starting to get the, you know, an independent call?

Well, that came through Cosmo. That came through Cosmo. After we had done the recordings with Dave Bartholomew, there were calls that would come in that for Cosmo to get some musicians together. And the recording, the studio band was the nucleus of the Dave Bartholomew band. Earl Palmer, Frank Fields, Ernest McElaine, and I had, they brought in Lee Allen from the Paul Gatons band to do it. And I was playing tenor, he was playing tenor, and somebody said, well, Ray, why don't you get a baritone? So I did.
